design_challenge_decisions.challenge: D-002 as stated — stale responses must reset loading=false
design_challenge_decisions.rationale: D-002 as written was itself the bug. Stale branches must be silent no-ops; only the matching generation's completion branch owns loading transitions. CF-013 + CF-016 both required for correctness.

design_challenge_decisions.challenge: SessionActions struct required by D-001; plan CS-006 says raw WriteSignal — plan internal contradiction
design_challenge_decisions.rationale: D-001 (Zero-Trace) is a hard design invariant. SessionState::error and authenticating were never cleared on lock with raw WriteSignal. SessionActions struct (plan Assumption 8) chosen over CS-006 raw WriteSignal. User delegated autonomously.
